limitations: Counterevidence: The correct suspension direction appears in Corollary4.6.5, the general shift theorem and introductory p156. Remark4.6.8(i), printedp339/PDF191, explicitly states general nonperiodicity of genuine L-spectra and refers to a computation over Z in paperIII. Combining the printed middle equivalence with Corollary4.6.5 would force four-periodicity of Lgs.

Limitations: The genuine symmetric L-spectrum computation over Z cited in Remark4.6.8(i) was not independently reconstructed. No new ring-level computation is claimed. The incorrect concluding restatement has no identified essential proof dependency in the inspected argument; excluded display-inconsistency classification is retained.
